Control Purpose: Control access rights and secure authentication
Recommended Action: Implement phishing-resistant MFA and restrict database permissions
Evidence Required: MFA settings and permission review evidence

Control Purpose: Protect endpoint devices and information outside company premises
Recommended Action: Enable full-disk encryption and enforce device security
Evidence Required: Encryption status and managed device inventory

Control Purpose: Manage identities and authenticate securely and monitor activity
Recommended Action: Enforce MFA and monitor suspicious sign-ins
Evidence Required: Identity configuration and sign-in monitoring reports

Control Purpose: Protect against malware and vulnerabilities and preserve recoverability
Recommended Action: Deploy endpoint protection and patch systems and maintain backups
Evidence Required: Endpoint reports and patch records and restore tests

Control Purpose: Classify information and manage authorised access
Recommended Action: Restrict HR data access and perform access reviews
Evidence Required: HR permissions and access review evidence

Control Purpose: Govern acceptable use of information and cloud services and reduce data leakage
Recommended Action: Establish approved AI tools and data handling rules
Evidence Required: AI use policy and tool inventory and data protection records

Control Purpose: Manage vulnerabilities and configurations and test application security
Recommended Action: Patch website components and perform authorised security testing
Evidence Required: Patch records and vulnerability assessment reports

Control Purpose: Protect backups and prepare ICT services for continuity
Recommended Action: Protect backups and conduct restoration tests
Evidence Required: Backup configuration and restoration test evidence

Control Purpose: Manage privileged access rights and restrict information access
Recommended Action: Apply least privilege and review privileged accounts
Evidence Required: Privileged account inventory and approved access reviews

Control Purpose: Secure authentication and improve awareness and maintain logging
Recommended Action: Enforce MFA and phishing awareness and payment verification
Evidence Required: Authentication configuration and training records and payment procedures
